name: cation_analytic_8g
purpose: Pool 3 P3-2, phase 1 of the larger cations (the user, 20 Oct: 'Ja, start fase 1'): the 30 of runner a's 60 cations still without both analytic UKS Hessians (B3LYP + ωB97X, 6-31G*, grid 99,590), smallest basis first, now under an 8,192 MB cap beside the DF-MP2 anchors' 5,120 MB (13 GB in all). The run stops itself at the first molecule over the cap (exit 4, by design); phase 2 (12 GB, the rest) follows only while no training chain runs
command: bash ../progress_on_growth.sh --tag CAP --dir ../../modules/05_support_predictor/corpus/shards_pool3/a/molecules --name pyscf.log -- env CAP_MB=8192 bash ../cation_analytic_all.sh

estimate.basis: a power law over the 10 measured cations (100-177 basis functions; cation_analytic logs): wall h = exp(-10.59) n^2.15, peak RSS GB = exp(-6.34) n^1.52 — 14 of the 30 (183-234 bf) fit 8 GB with 10 % headroom; an extrapolation beyond 177 bf, so the cap is the guard

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops a molecule at 8192 MB (CAP_MB; pyscf max_memory 7608). Measured max RSS 4.95 GB at 177 basis functions under the 5120 MB cap (20 Oct 01:18)
